mechanism: Amphetamine increases cardiovascular stimulation and sympathomimetic effects which may be potentiated by progesterone's effects on vascular reactivity and fluid retention, while progesterone may alter amphetamine metabolism via CYP3A4 inhibition.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and mood changes; counsel on amphetamine abuse potential which may be increased during luteal phase; consider alternative stimulants if cardiac risk factors present.
